title: Avatar
body: An avatar is a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most 5 MB. The server takes the type from the content of the file, not from its name. ^b6nc
A person uploads at most 100 files in an hour. ^dg6c

Uploaded files are private unless the operator sets `FILE_VISIBILITY` to `public`: the server signs a link for the person who asks, and the link stops working after `FILE_LINK_TTL_MINUTES` minutes, 60 unless set. ^t25x
A profile cannot point at a file another person uploaded; a link to another site is kept as given. An uploaded avatar is stored with the profile when the person presses Save changes. ^35w7
